modules.name: Common proxy policy builder
modules.responsibility: Produce provider definitions, health-checks, proxy groups, ordered fallbacks, and common rules from one policy implementation.
modules.interface: Accept AppConfig policy settings, provider source URLs, source-specific request metadata, and the profile BASE default; load the validated SEED snapshot from the configured state cache and return the common policy plus snapshot metadata.
modules.seam: Generated user and gateway profile projections compared through their public renderer interfaces.

modules.name: Profile source adapters
modules.responsibility: Supply each renderer's private and shared provider source while preserving source-specific metadata.
modules.interface: User profiles provide the published subctl provider URL; gateway profiles provide the configured upstream URL and retain gateway BASE=PROXY.
modules.seam: Provider URL, fetch route, and source-specific request headers in generated profiles.

modules.name: Gateway runtime envelope
modules.responsibility: Add gateway-only runtime and bootstrap routing around the shared proxy policy.
modules.interface: Compose unchanged TUN, DNS, listener, controller, interface, protected-host, and direct bootstrap-rule sections with the shared policy.
modules.seam: Exact gateway profile tests and Mihomo config validation.

modules.name: Legacy setting compatibility
modules.responsibility: Keep old provider-download settings loadable without allowing them to fork canonical routing.
modules.interface: Accept and validate the old field for persisted config compatibility; omit it from new UI edits and mark it deprecated in configuration docs.
modules.seam: Config parsing tests and UI bundle build.

interfaces.name: Common proxy policy generation
operations: build PRIVATE, PROVIDER-AUTO, AUTO, PROXY, BASE, GLOBAL, and recovery groups
build common rules ending in MATCH,BASE
interfaces.idempotency: The same configuration, state-cache snapshot, sources, and request metadata produce the same policy structure.

interfaces.name: Profile source composition
operations: compose the public feed-backed user profile
interfaces.idempotency: Repeated rendering preserves each profile type's provider source while delegating shared policy to one builder.

interfaces.name: Gateway runtime composition
interfaces.idempotency: The same gateway inputs preserve the same server-specific envelope and rule prefix.

interfaces.name: Legacy settings compatibility
operations: exclude the deprecated field from new settings submissions
interfaces.idempotency: Old settings remain loadable and cannot change the canonical fetch groups.

transitions.guard: The inline SEED group has at least one usable node.
transitions.action: Reject an empty LIVE group and continue to the canonical SEED fallback.

transitions.guard: Neither provider-backed child group has a usable node.
transitions.action: Do not claim a usable automatic route.

transitions.event: PRIVATE is empty or unhealthy during provider fetch
transitions.action: Advance to the next configured fetch fallback.

transitions.event: SEED is unavailable during provider fetch
transitions.guard: The provider request can use DIRECT.
transitions.action: Attempt the final direct fetch fallback.

failure_handling.failure: A renderer branch constructs provider policy independently.
failure_handling.response: Policy parity tests fail; both renderers must use the shared builder.

failure_handling.failure: A legacy setting changes gateway provider routing.
failure_handling.response: Compatibility tests fail; the value remains parseable but cannot override the shared FETCH groups.

failure_handling.failure: Generated YAML is rejected by Mihomo.
failure_handling.response: Treat validation as failed and keep production render/redeploy out of scope until corrected.
